title: 182949名跑者报名创纪录 3万选手金秋开跑北京马拉松（北京市体育局/北京日报）
publisher: 北京市体育局（北京日报）
claims: The 2024 Beijing Marathon started at 07:30 on Sunday 3 November 2024 at Tiananmen Square with a 30,000-strong field; 182,949 runners from 43 countries and regions entered, a record at the time, and Beijing residents made up 21.1% of entrants.
Men's winner Lemi Berhanu Hayle (Ethiopia) ran 2:09:16; Betwel Kibet Jumba was second; Chen Tianyu was third in 2:09:48 and won the National Championships men's title.
Women's winner Vicoty Chepng'ok (Kenya) ran 2:21:56; Rahma Tusa (Ethiopia) was second and Angela Tanui (Kenya) third; Liu Min won the National Championships women's title in 2:28:36.
For 2024 the start arch on the square's east-side road was moved 100 metres north; all runners assembled on the east-side road for a straight start.
The pre-race marathon expo at the National Convention Centre covered 13,000 square metres; an 800-family children's fun run was held at the Olympic Green.
